methodology.name: Neon Tokyo Daily JP Backtest v1
methodology.note: Backtest replays scoring using historical bars already saved in prices-jp/latest.json. It does not fetch external data.
methodology.return_measurement: Entry at evaluation date close; future returns use trading-day offsets.
methodology.alpha_measurement: Stock future return minus TOPIX ETF future return for same horizon.
